title: First run: food and drink, metal and gear
summary: Both trial chains sit on the curve: Cooking and Smithing each reach 99 in 15.1 days for an optimized player (the curve says 15.3) and about 27 days for a typical one, with no empty stretches in either. The run found three slips in the page's own sums, now fixed, and two things that need the owner's call.
checked: Cooking: 99 recipes, one per level from 1 to 99. No level is more than 15 % off the curve. No empty stretches.
Smithing: 77 recipes. No level is more than 15 % off the curve. No empty stretches; the longest run with nothing new is 5 levels (93 to 98).
Every ingredient arrives in time: the worst wait is a new metal's ingot waiting about 20 minutes on its ore, far inside the wall rule.
Gathering behind the work: a darkmetal Chestplate needs about 10 minutes of gathering for 41 seconds at the anvil, in line with the rules' 9 gatherers per crafter at darkmetal with no boosts.
Not checked yet: the ledger's own timing. The ledger read-out isn't built and the plan isn't in the CMS, so these are the page's numbers only.
moved: Fixed: late food was costed like armour. A Voidcap Pie took 3 Dough (the page read cap), a Harvest Platter 5 Bread (vest), Swordfish in Sofrito 2 Sofrito (sword). Food, drinks and potions now always take 1 of a made ingredient.
Fixed: Water is 1 in every recipe, as the rules say. Late soups and teas were asking for 3 to 5 Water.

Fixed: an unlock no longer moves below the level of an ingredient from another skill. Elixir of Ironskin stays at 8 (it had moved to 6, below its Clay), and four arrows stay with their arrowheads. This brings back an empty stretch at Alchemy 2 to 7 and two short ones in Fletching, for week 2.

Adjusted, inside the limits: action lengths are trimmed by up to 15 % so whole XP pays the rule's XP an hour exactly. A Copper Ingot is 8.9 s for 3 XP (was 8.1 s), a Copper Dagger 11.5 s for 4 XP (was 12.2 s). Early recipes no longer pay unevenly from rounding.
Unlock moves in the two chains: Copper Chestplate 13 to 16 and Adamantine Chestplate 73 to 76, each to break up a long run with nothing new before the next metal.
Two new dials to try, both set to the rules as they stand: Longer per extra bar, and Boosts between tiers.

proposals.question: Should the optimized player's boosts climb level by level instead of stepping up at each tier?
proposals.why: XP per action is cut by the boosts a good player holds, and that cut jumps at each new metal. So the first recipes of a new tier pay a hero less than the last recipes of the old one: a Darkmetal Ingot at 80 pays 14 % less a second than an Adamantine Chestplate, Coconut Pie at 80 pays 17 % less than Coconut Swordfish at 79. It happens at every tier in both chains (10 Cooking recipes, 8 Smithing) and lasts about three levels each time.

options.label: Climb level by level
options.text: Every new recipe pays more than the last, in both chains. Time to 99 stays at 15.2 to 15.3 days optimized; a typical player takes about 28 days instead of 27.

options.label: Keep the steps
options.text: No change. A new tier opens with about three levels where the old work still pays best, then the new work overtakes.

proposals.tryIt: set Boosts between tiers to climb each level and watch Cooking and Smithing on Item numbers.

proposals.question: How much longer should a piece of gear take for each extra bar it uses?
proposals.why: Today each extra bar adds 20 %, so a 5-bar Chestplate takes 1.8x a 1-bar Dagger and pays 1.8x the XP. The smith's XP an hour is the same either way, but Daggers use far less metal: a bar spent on Daggers earns 2.8x the XP of a bar spent on Chestplates. A guild short on ore levels Smithing fastest by making Daggers.

options.label: +50 % a bar
options.text: A Chestplate takes 3x a Dagger (36 s at copper, 69 s at darkmetal). A bar in Daggers earns 1.7x a bar in Chestplates: still the thrifty choice, no longer the only sensible one.

options.label: Keep +20 %
options.text: Chestplates stay quick (24 s at copper, 41 s at darkmetal). Daggers stay 2.8x better per bar.

options.label: +100 % a bar
options.text: XP per bar is the same for every piece. A Chestplate takes 5x a Dagger: a minute at copper, nearly two at darkmetal.

proposals.tryIt: move Longer per extra bar. Pace doesn't change; look at Action and XP an action for Smithing on Item numbers.

gaps: The other skills' stretches are still the solver's raw list, to be reviewed in week 2: docs/active/balance_gaps.md.
waiting: On the director: the ledger read-out and the ledger's new tiers and boost budget (brief 880, L1 to L3). Until then the page can't be checked against the engine.
On the content session: the plan in the CMS as Planned entries. No number pack before that.
On the balancer, as week 1 reaches them: how many Nails, Arrowheads and Kunai one bar makes, and how long a drink's dose lasts. No rule sets these yet, so the page shows them as 1 a craft.

The worked examples in BALANCE_RULES.md were written before the boost budget was counted and are a little high (a Copper Ingot shows 4 XP; the page says 3). They get regenerated once this run's proposals are answered.
